title: refactor: extract console MSW mode into shared kernel factory following upstream studio pattern
body:
Console's MSW mock setup duplicated kernel bootstrapping and handler creation across `browser.ts` and `server.ts`. Per the upstream `@objectstack/studio` pattern in the spec repo, this should be factored into reusable modules that can be composed as a plugin.

### Shared kernel factory (`mocks/createKernel.ts`)

Encapsulates ObjectKernel + ObjectQL + InMemoryDriver + AppPlugin bootstrap into a single factory, mirroring `@objectstack/studio`'s `createKernel()`:

```typescript
import { createKernel } from './createKernel';

const { kernel, driver } = await createKernel({ appConfig });
```

### Shared handler factory (`mocks/handlers.ts`)

Extracts the ~200 lines of duplicated MSW handler definitions into `createHandlers()`. Handles both browser (relative wildcard paths) and Node.js test (absolute URLs) environments automatically.

### Simplified `browser.ts` / `server.ts`

Both reduced to thin wrappers (271→72 and 227→59 lines respectively) that compose the shared factories with MSW's `setupWorker` / `setupServer`.

### Functional CLI `studio` command

`objectui studio` was a stub. Now resolves the console app in the workspace and delegates to `pnpm run dev`, starting Vite + MSW for in-browser metadata preview.
